rules.description: List of access control rules for zone transfers. Each rule specifies a network in CIDR notation, an action (allow or deny), and optionally a tag for logging.

cidr.description: IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR block (e.g., '192.0.2.0/24' or '2001:db8::/32')

action.description: Whether to allow or deny transfers from this network

tag.description: Optional tag to include in log entries for this rule (e.g., 'internal', 'cdn')
